name: Barbell Overhead Squat
steps: Stand in your squat stance holding a barbell locked straight overhead with a wide snatch grip and shoulders pushed actively upward.
Brace your core tightly and set the bar balanced directly over the middle of your feet.
Bend your hips and knees together to descend into a full squat while keeping your arms locked and chest proud.
Drive evenly through your feet to stand tall while keeping the bar stacked steadily overhead.
tips: Press actively upward into the bar with locked elbows throughout the entire squat.
Keep your armpits facing slightly forward to stabilize your shoulders under load.
